facts.fact: Minister Emma Kantema told the National Assembly on 2026-09-08 that 10,066 of 15,785 suspended old-age, child-welfare and other social-grant beneficiaries had been reinstated and paid through the government payment system.
The ministry's verification exercise checked grant beneficiaries' identities against the national population register administered by home affairs, and some records did not match.

systems.owner: Ministry of Gender Equality, Poverty Eradication and Social Welfare with the finance ministry
systems.tiers: old-age, child-welfare and other social grants
